question: Will [Creator] mention Bitcoin on X in the next 24 hours?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if a post authored by [Creator] on X (formerly Twitter) that explicitly mentions "Bitcoin" or "BTC" is publicly visible and timestamped within the 24-hour window following the market's opening time, as confirmed at the market's settlement time.
- "No": Wins if no such post by [Creator] on X mentioning "Bitcoin" or "BTC" is found within the 24-hour window at the market's settlement time.

Clarifications:
- The 24-hour window begins at market open and ends at the market's settlement time. Reposts (retweets) of another account's content count only if [Creator] added original text mentioning "Bitcoin" or "BTC". Quoted retweets with no added text do not count. Replies count if they contain "Bitcoin" or "BTC" in [Creator]'s own reply text. Posts that are deleted before the market's settlement time do not count.
